prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, two floors of a 1930s building cut open in cross-section like a doll's house, seen straight on. Bottom: a black brick furnace room where a thin bald gangster with big ears in a sweat-soaked vest and pinstripe trousers shovels heaps of blank green paper money with no printing into the roaring mouth of a huge iron furnace, orange fire pouring out across the floor. From the furnace a fat copper heating pipe climbs the wall up into the floor above, a secret basement full of gangsters in pinstripes lounging warm under emerald lamps, and there the pipe stops dead, capped under the basement ceiling. Above the cut, a thin strip of the shop floor upstairs: dark, frost on the floorboards, icicles. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest values are the furnace mouth and the copper pipe catching its glow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
